other_conditions: The unit must have its operations located in Goa
The applicant must be a Proprietorship Firm, Private Limited Company, Public Limited Company, Registered Partnership Firm, or Limited Liability Partnership
The unit must be registered with the Goa Energy Development Agency (GEDA) for solar power production
The bank accounts of the unit and/or its partner(s)/director(s) must be linked to Aadhaar
benefits_summary: Units operating in Goa on 100% solar energy are eligible for a reimbursement of 10% of the capital cost of the solar power installation, up to a maximum of ₹50,00,000, subject to budgetary allocation and only for expenditures incurred during operation.
